capabilities: Colors MarkMind Basic nodes by hierarchy level
Colors branch curves to match the node's level
Colors underline segments using logical tree traversal
Re-applies colors after layout or render changes
Adapts the palette to light and dark mode
extras: Unofficial companion plugin, not affiliated with MarkMind or Obsidian; MarkMind must be installed separately. Only MarkMind Basic mode is supported (Rich mode untested). It depends on MarkMind's rendered DOM/SVG structure, so a future MarkMind update may require compatibility changes. No network requests or analytics.
intentEvidence: A tiny, lazy companion plugin for Obsidian that automatically colors MarkMind Basic mind maps
problem: MarkMind Basic mind maps do not color nodes by depth automatically, so the tree's level structure is hard to read without manual coloring.
